title: [ATen] Handle vectorized_loop tail with masked vop, not scalar op (#197018)
body:
Summary:
X-link: https://github.com/pytorch/executorch/pull/22882


Within vectorized_loop, also use vectorized vop for the scalars in the tensor's tail.

Otherwise, the same f(x) can give different results depending on the input's position within the tensor

Test Plan: CI

Differential Revision: D120020856
